card.tagline: Turkey, 2017 — form of performing arts characteristic of Turkmenistani culture, combining improvised poetry, dance, and song
card.profile: Küştdepdi is a form of performing arts characteristic of Turkmenistani culture, combining improvised poetry, dance, and song. Küştdepdi has been preserved as a ritual and entertainment component of traditional celebrations. In 2017, the tradition was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in English as the Kushtdepdi rite of singing and dancing and in Turkmen as Küştdepdi aýdym we tans dessury.
card.insight:
== International recognition ==
On December 7, 2017, the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in Jeju, South Korea, unanimously inscribed the Kushtdepdi rite of singing and dancing on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists.
